rv.q: And, yes, believe the hype: Yorke’s arrangements are tremendous. Performed by a five-piece band, isolated in sound booths and accompanied with much reverb by singers Megan Hill and Ed Begley, it rumbles and twitches, erupting in great swells of electro-rock noise at the moments of greatest intensity.
Technically spectacular, Radiohead’s 2003 concept album in conversation with Shakespeare is an innovation in form
